subject: LinQ Health — PO prerequisites, EIN & remit info
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@linqhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LinQ Health — PO prerequisites, EIN & remit info

Hi Anna,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Redwood live for the LinQ clinical insights pipeline. Finance asked me to confirm a handful of items so we can be registered in your AP system and ensure the first invoice ties cleanly to your PO. Can you confirm the exact fields your AP portal requires? From our side, the usual asks are:

- Company legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN/Tax ID (US): 82-1234567
- Remit-to bank details (for EFT/ACH) — we can provide via secure form or signed mandate
- Billing contact + email for invoice delivery (PDF via AP portal + copy to billing@redwood.ai)
- PO number format (prefix / max length) and whether you require PO line-item mapping
- Any additional tax documentation (W-9 for US, or VAT registration docs for EU subsidiaries)

I attached our W-9 and a sample PO-to-invoice mapping PDF to speed things up. If you prefer, Laura (cc'd, finance) can hop on a 20-min call with your AP team to walk through the portal fields.

Next steps I suggest: you send the portal field list (or invite Redwood to register) and we’ll complete registration within 24–48 hours.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: redwood_W9.pdf (W-9, PDF); PO_template_sample.pdf (example mapping PDF)

From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@linqhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: LinQ Health AP <ap@linqhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: LinQ Health — PO prerequisites, EIN & remit info

Hi Ben,

Thanks — that list is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Required fields in our AP portal (minimum): legal name, EIN/Tax ID, remit-to bank (routing + account), invoice delivery method (portal vs email), billing contact name/email, and tax form type (W-9/W-8/WHT exemption).
2) PO numbers: our POs are 10 digits, prefixed with LH (example: LH00012345). We need the PO number included as a top-level field on the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata when uploaded to the portal.
3) EU/VAT: LinQ has an EU subsidiary, but invoices for this purchase will route to the US entity — no reverse-charge expected. However, if Redwood intends to bill an EU entity later, we’ll request VAT registration docs then.
4) Security: for remit/bank details we require a signed vendor banking mandate or a secure upload to our portal — no bank info by plain email.

I’ve looped our AP team; they will send a portal invite to supplier-registration@redwood.ai by end of day. Meanwhile, please provide a completed remit spreadsheet (I attached the template) and the W-9 (you already attached — thanks).

Anna
Anna Ruiz
Procurement Manager, LinQ Health
anna.ruiz@linqhealth.com

Attachments from Anna: LinQ_remit_template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@linqhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, LinQ Health AP <ap@linqhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LinQ Health — PO prerequisites, EIN & remit info

Anna —

Great, appreciate the clarity. A few confirmations from our side:

- I’ll attach a completed remit spreadsheet and a redacted bank mandate (we’ll upload full mandate to your portal once invited).
- W-9 is attached (redwood_W9.pdf) — that covers tax ID for the US billing.
- Preferred invoice delivery: we typically send a PDF to the portal and cc billing@redwood.ai. If LinQ prefers portal-only for initial submission, we’ll follow that.
- Payment terms: as discussed in contract, Net 45 standard. If LinQ requires Net 30 for AP reasons, please confirm so we can reflect on the invoice.

Laura — could you confirm the exact remit bank file (xlsx) I should populate and whether finance needs a pre-signed vendor banking mandate for LinQ’s vendor record?

I uploaded our completed remit file and a signed-but-redacted bank mandate to our secure Docs link and included the DocuSign envelope for the PO amendment (link below). We’ll finalize once you send the portal invite.

Best,
Ben

Attachments: Redwood_remit_instructions.xlsx (completed), redwood_W9.pdf (again), Redwood_Bank_Mandate_redacted.pdf
Links: https://app.redwood.example/docusign/LINQ-089

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LinQ Health — PO prerequisites, EIN & remit info

Hi Anna / Ben,

Thanks — confirming finance checklist so LinQ has everything to create a vendor record:

- Legal name + DBA (if different) — Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN: 82-1234567 (W-9 attached)
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc. — ACH details provided in the bank mandate. We will not email full routing/account numbers; we’ll upload to your portal once invited.
- Invoice header requirements: Invoice number, invoice date, invoice total, PO number (exact string), line-item descriptions matching PO lines (if provided).
- Billing contact for inquiries: billing@redwood.ai (monitored by finance team).
- Payment terms: Net 45 (contract); we can accept Net 30 if your AP requires it — let us know before first invoice.

Karthik, we need confirmation on whether Redwood should include a specific vendor tax classification or if LinQ will classify the vendor on their side.

Anna — if you can send the portal invite to supplier-registration@redwood.ai, we’ll complete registration today and confirm the vendor ID back to you so you can provision the PO.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Hi all,

Portal invite sent to supplier-registration@redwood.ai moments ago. Next steps from LinQ AP:

- Complete the supplier registration form in the portal (legal name, EIN, remit DB, contact emails).
- Upload W-9 and bank mandate to the secure supplier documents section.
- Once we approve the vendor record, I’ll raise PO LH00034567 against the SOW and send the final PO PDF to the portal.

Payment terms on the PO will be Net 45 (per contract). If Redwood later requests Net 30, we can evaluate for future SOWs but the initial PO will be Net 45.

Ben — once you accept the portal invite, please reply here with the created LinQ vendor ID so our operations team can link the PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
